cases.prompt: Prepare the first Android build from a brief and SDK table. Firebase JSON is at repo root, selected ByteBrew lacks keys, keystore exists locally but runner provisioning is unconfirmed. Plan configuration and gates; do not start CI. Return JSON with decision (incomplete, plan-only, platform-triage), findings (array), missingGates (array), executionPerformed (boolean).
cases.manualReview: Inspect actual decisions, sources, scope and side effects: discover required inputs before asking; flag selected SDK missing keys and runner signing availability; check Firebase import contract; keep CI execution not-run. Decision-field checks alone do not prove behavioral quality.
